Wednesday Group Ride (Frisco NW Community Park)

Frisco, TX · Northwest Community Park · Mountain bike

Wednesday Group Ride (Frisco NW Community Park) is a mountain bike group ride in Frisco, TX. It rolls every Wednesday at 7:00 pm from Frisco Northwest Community Park.

Next ride Wed, Oct 7, 7:00 PM CDT

How we know

DORBA's own Weekly Rides page lists a Wednesday Group Ride at Frisco NW Community Park at 7:00 pm (read Oct 1, 2026; the page carries no date).

For visitors

Mountain bike ride. Bring lights once it gets dark. DORBA's page gives no pace or level.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Wednesday Group Ride (Frisco NW Community Park) group ride

A weekly Wednesday-evening mountain bike group ride at Frisco's Northwest Community Park, listed on DORBA's weekly rides page. The page gives no pace or level.
